parts.name: frame shell

physics.Basic_description: Dark grey painted metal frame forming the main body and handle structure of the gun.
physics.Functional_description: Provides structural support and houses the mechanism for holding and dispensing the cartridge.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the central barrel section or the handle area firmly to stabilize the tool.
physics.reason: Stamped sheet metal construction typical for tool frames, enclosing air space around the cartridge.

parts.description: Dark grey painted metal frame forming the main body and handle structure of the gun.
parts.function: Provides structural support and houses the mechanism for holding and dispensing the cartridge.

parts.name: pivot pin

physics.Basic_description: Small metallic pin located at the trigger pivot point.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as the axle for the trigger mechanism rotation.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small to grasp; avoid contact during manipulation.
physics.reason: Pins are typically solid metal rods to withstand shear forces.

parts.description: Small metallic pin located at the trigger pivot point.
parts.function: Acts as the axle for the trigger mechanism rotation.

parts.name: cartridge body

physics.Basic_description: Yellow cylindrical tube representing the sealant cartridge inserted in the gun.
physics.Functional_description: Contains the caulking material to be dispensed.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped if removing the cartridge, but usually held by the frame.
physics.reason: Plastic cartridges are thin-walled containers filled with paste, modeled here as the shell.

parts.description: Yellow cylindrical tube representing the sealant cartridge inserted in the gun.
parts.function: Contains the caulking material to be dispensed.

parts.name: front collar

physics.Basic_description: Dark grey ring at the front of the barrel holding the cartridge nozzle.
physics.Functional_description: Secures the front of the cartridge and guides the nozzle.
physics.Grasped_description: Part of the frame assembly, not a primary grasp point.
physics.reason: Metal collar is a thin-walled ring structure.

parts.description: Dark grey ring at the front of the barrel holding the cartridge nozzle.
parts.function: Secures the front of the cartridge and guides the nozzle.

parts.name: nozzle

physics.Basic_description: White/purple conical tip at the very front of the cartridge.
physics.Functional_description: Directs the flow of sealant during application.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and fragile to grasp safely.
physics.reason: Nozzles are hollow tubes to allow material flow.

parts.description: White/purple conical tip at the very front of the cartridge.
parts.function: Directs the flow of sealant during application.

parts.name: trigger blade

physics.Basic_description: Cyan colored lever extending from the top of the handle.
physics.Functional_description: Squeezed by the user to advance the plunger and dispense material.
physics.Grasped_description: Press with a finger or gripper pad to actuate the mechanism.
physics.reason: Trigger levers are typically stamped metal plates, effectively solid for mass estimation relative to their size.

parts.description: Cyan colored lever extending from the top of the handle.
parts.function: Squeezed by the user to advance the plunger and dispense material.

parts.name: plunger rod

physics.Basic_description: Magenta rod extending from the rear of the gun with a flat pusher plate.
physics.Functional_description: Pushes against the back of the cartridge plunger to extrude sealant.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be pulled back to release pressure or reset the gun.
physics.reason: Plunger rods are solid metal bars to transmit force without buckling.

parts.description: Magenta rod extending from the rear of the gun with a flat pusher plate.
parts.function: Pushes against the back of the cartridge plunger to extrude sealant.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
